name: tickets
note: N5a: tickets. The player stands still in a. b is 300 m away (backdrop by distance): a ticket pins it at sideline from world tick 100 for 300 ticks, then it falls back. c is 60 m away (sideline by distance): a ticket pins it at backdrop from tick 200 for 200 ticks, then it comes back at once. d is far: a ticket sends it to ledger from tick 300 for 250 ticks (unloaded, then rebuilt from its seed).
